steps.title: Update Database Helper for Photo Schema
steps.description: Increment database version to 3 and add image_path column migration for medicines, customers, suppliers, sales, and purchases tables.

steps.title: Implement High Quality PhotoHelper Utility
steps.description: Update PhotoHelper to preserve raw resolution streams, handle high-definition camera capture URIs, process EXIF orientation, generate separate sharp thumbnails, and display full-screen previews with pinch zoom.

steps.title: Update Manifest Permissions and Camera Features
steps.description: Declare CAMERA permission and hardware feature with optional flag in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Add Localization Strings for Photo Options
steps.description: Add photo options (Take Photo, Choose Gallery, Replace, Remove) to English and Hindi resource bundles.

steps.title: Update Customer Directory Photo Handling
steps.description: Integrate high-resolution camera intent and non-destructive photo stream saving into Customer creation and Khata activities.

steps.title: Update Medicine Inventory Photo Quality
steps.description: Integrate full-resolution photo capture and gallery preservation into Medicine management.

steps.title: Add Optional Photo Support to Supplier Directory
steps.description: Update supplier list layout and activity to display optional supplier profile thumbnails.

steps.title: Update Sales Billing Attachment Quality
steps.description: Enable full-resolution prescription/receipt attachment photo capture in Sales billing.

steps.title: Update Purchase Invoice Photo Attachment
steps.description: Enable uncompressed invoice bill photo attachment capture in New Purchase screen.

steps.title: Integrate Photos Folder into ZIP Backup and Restore
steps.description: Ensure ZIP backup preserves full-resolution original photo files and restores them without recompression.

steps.title: Building Mumbai Medical
steps.description: Recompile Mumbai Medical application with full high-resolution photo quality, EXIF rotation support, and pinch zoom full-screen preview.
